topic: Classification of aircraft, arrangements of major components and their functions
syllabus_extract: Classification of aircraft, arrangements of major components and their functions
specific_objectives: 11.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain aircraft structure, various structural elements and their details.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of component arrangement diagrams; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What are the primary functions of an aircraft structure?
Can you list three major components of an aircraft?
How is an aircraft generally classified based on its configuration?

development.content:
Classification of aircraft by configuration
Classification by propulsion type
Classification by mission role
Classification by size and capacity
Classification by wing configuration

Arrangement of fuselage and cockpit
Wing structure and control surfaces
Empennage components and functions
Landing gear types and mechanisms
Powerplant location and integration

topics: Structural elements: skin, frames, and ribs
development.content:
Structural elements: skin, frames, and ribs
Load distribution and stress analysis
Material selection for airframe
Fastening methods and joints
Corrosion protection and maintenance access

summary_questions: Explain the difference between monoplane and biplane configurations.
Describe the function of the horizontal stabilizer in the empennage.
How does the landing gear arrangement affect aircraft performance?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the design requirements for the next lesson (LP 02) focusing on how classification influences manufacturing processes.
